connectionreference.connectionreferencedescription: Microsoft Dataverse connection owned by the service account. Used by all four Phase 1 flows to read and write rev_applicant, rev_application, rev_setting and rev_errorlog.

Microsoft Teams connection owned by the service account. Posts 1:1 chat messages to the process owner only - never a channel post (ADR-015), so personal data in a notification reaches one named recipient.
Office 365 Outlook connection owned by the service account. The documented fallback channel when the Teams connector is unavailable (TAD section 4), sending from rev_ServiceMailbox.

DocuSign connection owned by the service account. Used by REV | Acceptance | Create Envelope (wbs:3.2, Automation #3, DEV only per EX-006/EX-007) to send the acceptance envelope built from the reviewer's own DocuSign template. DLP grouping (Business) already settled at TAD section 6.4.

SharePoint connection owned by the service account. Used by REV | Acceptance | Completion (wbs:3.4, Automation #3, DEV only per EX-006/EX-007) to upload the signed acceptance PDF to the designated site's per-environment library (ADR-014, ADR-G01).
